themes.description: Users are consistently experiencing frustration and disappointment with the company's customer support service, citing long wait times, unhelpful representatives, and poor communication.
themes.business_impact: High customer dissatisfaction, potential loss of revenue due to unmet customer needs, damage to brand reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient training or inadequate resources for customer support representatives, inefficient process or inadequate technology for handling customer inquiries.
themes.action_plan:
• Improve customer support process and staffing, provide regular training and support for customer support representatives
• Develop and implement a clear and efficient process for handling customer inquiries
• Expand language support to cater to diverse customer base
• Utilize technology to enhance customer support experience, such as automation and AI-powered chatbots.

themes.description: Users are extremely dissatisfied with the high brokerage charges and poor user interface. They find it difficult to navigate and perform transactions without any hiccups. Many users expressed frustration over the hidden charges, high brokerage fees, and lack of transparency in the fees structure.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage fees may result in significant revenue loss due to user churn, as users are actively seeking alternative platforms with better fees and user experience. The poor UI will also negatively impact user experience, potentially leading to increased support requests and lower engagement.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient research and testing on user experience and fees structure have led to a subpar platform. Lack of competitive pricing and transparency has driven users away, resulting in significant revenue loss. Inadequate design and development of the user interface has failed to provide a seamless experience for users, leading to frustration and user dissatisfaction.
themes.action_plan: • Conduct user research to re-design the UI for a seamless experience Improve transparency on fees structure by clearly displaying all charges Reduce brokerage fees to industry standards or lower Develop a more competitive pricing strategy to attract and retain users

themes.description: Users reported several app-related issues, including bugs, hidden charges, and poor user experience. The problems are widespread and occur frequently, affecting new and existing customers.
themes.business_impact: Substantial revenue loss due to app crashes, user churn, and negative word-of-mouth
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inconsistent development practices across teams, inadequate testing, and unclear guidelines for user experience enhancements.
themes.action_plan: • Review development methodologies for consistency, implement more comprehensive testing frameworks, and update UX guidelines for a unified user experience. Conduct thorough customer support training to handle bugs and hidden charges complaints effectively. Introduce regular feature updates with detailed changelogs to keep users informed about improvements.
